_comment: Standard card and TOTW slots select saved promo buckets and then an eligible member. Gold Rare and TOTW buckets initially use rating ranges; other standard categories start with one uniform bucket each. Since pack odds v3 (migration 117) every pack and pick group carries its own complete odds table (category_chances); there are no fallback chances. iconChance and picks.informChance are only the starting values the panel fills into a new pack or pick. TOTW 1–3 rewards and Champions red picks use fixed named pools, while Draft and Match Packs use their own slot rules.
_redRewardComment: The red FUT Champions copy of a fixed TOTW 1–3 reward card uses resource id = asset id + revision x 2^24. Try the copy made from that week's card first, then the player's all-time copy only when its rating matches.
_bandsComment: goldRareBands records the original seven Gold Rare ranges and weights. Gold Rare and TOTW draws read the saved card groups.
_picksComment: Player picks use their own odds table and saved TOTW card groups; ordinary choices use saved Gold Rare groups filtered by minimum rating. Never offer two versions of one player.
_nonPlayerDropsComment: Every item a pack hands out besides players is drawn one way: a pool first, by its poolWeights entry among the pools the slot allows that have a candidate (mixed pack consumable slots allow chemistry_style, position_modifier and manager_league; cosmetic slots kit, ball, badge and stadium; staff slots manager), then an item from the pool, a rare one at rareWeight of a common one's chance. Within one mixed pack a slot kind does not repeat a pool until every pool it allows has dropped (a chemistry style, a position modifier and a league card before a second style). Rarity only sets how often an item drops and how it looks: a pack's rare slots are its rare players. Basic and GK Basic never drop (a player without a style card plays as them). A pool weight of 0 stops that pool dropping.
